diagnostics.message: The cleanup service account uses the controller namespace by name, but can be created before module.controller creates that namespace. Order it after module.controller (when that module manages the namespace).
The cleanup Role uses the controller namespace by name without waiting for module.controller to create it. Add ordering on module.controller when it manages this namespace.

The cleanup CronJob can start a Job before its service account's RoleBinding exists, causing authorization failures. Wait for kubernetes_role_binding_v1.zombie_runner_cleanup before enabling the CronJob.

The runner Helm release passes var.service_account into its pod configuration but does not wait for runner_sa. Runners can be launched before their service account exists. Reference kubernetes_service_account_v1.runner_sa[0].metadata[0].name for the template's service_account value, or add depends_on.
In k8s mode the runner release can launch runners before kubernetes_role_binding.k8s grants their service account permission to create job pods. Make the release wait for this RoleBinding.

The runner release references the IAM role but not its managed-policy attachments. It can launch runners before runner_role_policy_attachment grants the AWS permissions configured for their jobs. Order the release after the attachments.

The runner release can launch pods before eks_pod_identity associates their service account with the runner IAM role. For runners using EKS Pod Identity, wait for this association before installing the release.
